title: Be Wary of Homonyms
synopsis: Watch out for words in Mandarin with the same pronunciation but completely different meanings.

fullText.simplified:
注意同音词

    小何在八楼人事部工作，两个月前，被调到了六楼的广告部。一天，小何的同学打电话到人事部找他：“小何在吗？”接电话的同事说：“小何已经不在人事了。”
    小何的同学很惊讶：“什么？小何已经不在人世了？什么时候的事？我怎么不知道，我都没来得及送送他！”接电话的同事回答：“就两个月前的事。没关系，你可以去下面找他啊！”
    小何的同学很生气：“什么？你让我去下面找他？你是要我去死吗？”
    虽然这只是一个笑话，但我们可以知道，中文里有很多声调一样，但字不一样，意思也不一样的词语。比如这个笑话里的“人事”和“人世”，声调一样，但意思却完全不同。有时候，人们在没有看到字时，很容易理解错误。
fullText.traditional:
注意同音詞

    小何在八樓人事部工作，兩個月前，被調到了六樓的廣告部。一天，小何的同學打電話到人事部找他：“小何在嗎？”接電話的同事說：“小何已經不在人事了。”
    小何的同學很驚訝：“什麼？小何已經不在人世了？什麼時候的事？我怎麼不知道，我都沒來得及送送他！”接電話的同事回答：“就兩個月前的事。沒關係，你可以去下面找他啊！”
    小何的同學很生氣：“什麼？你讓我去下面找他？你是要我去死嗎？”
    雖然這只是一個笑話，但我們可以知道，中文裡有很多聲調一樣，但字不一樣，意思也不一樣的詞語。比如這個笑話裡的“人事”和“人世”，聲調一樣，但意思卻完全不同。有時候，人們在沒有看到字時，很容易理解錯誤。

raw.synopsis: Watch out for words in Mandarin with the same pronunciation but completely different meanings.
sentence_translations: Little He was working in the personnel department on the 8th floor.
Two months ago, he was transferred to the advertisement department on the 6th floor.
One day, Little He’s classmate called the personnel department looking for him: “Is Little He there?”
The colleague who answered the phone said: “Little He is no longer in the personnel department.”
Little He's classmate was surprised: “What? Little He is no longer in this world?”
“When did this happen? How come I didn't know? I didn't have a chance to send him off!”
The colleague who answered the phone said:
“It was just two months ago. It's alright, you can go down below to look for him.”
Little He's classmate got angry: “What? You're making me go down below to look for him? You want me to go die?”
Even though this is just a funny story, we can learn that ..
.. there are many words in Mandarin with identical tones, but with different characters and meaning.
For example “personnel” and “the world” from this funny story.
They have the same tones, but the meaning is completely different.
Sometimes when people can't see the characters, it is easy to misunderstand.
